title: NLO - HPGR Vibration High High Trip Debounce timer

fields.latestPosition: Correct Documentation to be supplied in order to close out. - PTS to review and confirm 14/08 PCS to review and close/implement 04/09
fields.nextAction: Confirm the 2 s debounce is live and close out
fields.statusConflict: Control System Engineer acknowledged 29/01/24 (Jason Ly), backup and killswitch ticked – may already be implemented
fields.why: NLO HPGR occasionally trips out on Vibration Shut Down alarm. After investigation, it has been concluded that the gearbox was normal, and the high vibration reading was temporary which could have been caused by the impact of falling rocks.
fields.design: Currently, this HPGR Vibration High High alarm has no debounce timer which means any nuisance high reading will immediately trip the drive. A 2-secound debounce timer shall be added to this high high alarm (like the high warning alarm) to avoid nuisance trip.
fields.impact: Momentary vibration spikes shorter than 2 s will no longer trip the NLO HPGR.
